title: pypdf has possible infinite loop when hitting EOF in standard xref table during trailer search (CVE-2026-119203)
description: pypdf versions prior to 6.21.4 contain a vulnerability where opening an incomplete PDF file without a trailer can cause an infinite loop during the search for the standard xref table. This flaw allows an attacker to craft a malicious PDF that triggers this behavior. The issue has been fixed in pypdf version 6.21.4.
